name: Hurricane And Storm
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign authority over hurricanes and storms, portraying Him as the eternal King who rules even over the floodwaters and tempestuous winds (Psalms 29:10; Nahum 1:3). The Bible shows that God can send mighty storms as a display of His power and judgment, as seen when He sent a great wind to challenge Jonah (Jonah 1:4) and as described in Isaiah where a storm symbolizes His mighty hand casting down the proud (Isaiah 28:2). Yet, these natural forces also demonstrate God's providence, as He sends rain and sunshine impartially to all people (Matthew 5:45), and those who build their lives on Christ, the solid rock, will withstand the storms of life (Matthew 7:25).
